description: Advance the game: shoot threats by id (auto-ranged), optionally use a zap, for a number of ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Returns what happened, a top-down radar and every threat sorted by time to impact.

city.description: City index for a dome zap.

targets.description: Threat or aircraft ids to shoot, in order, as fast as the gun reloads (about 7 a second). Each shot bursts where the target will be.

zap.description: Optional zap on the first tick (3 per game): flash kills everything, pulse kills near and stalls far, dome shields one city.

name: step
title: Play a step
